method_change: when an audit reports something absent, run `git log --diff-filter=D` for it before concluding it was never built. Three of four absences this campaign were deletions, and the fourth was a relocation.
note_on_the_deleting_commits: these were not vandalism. 791ced2c consolidated 129 modules into 44 carefully, retiring each campaign with its specification, fixture, receipt, reproduction command and reopen condition. 8b0c5405 is the one that went too far, and its message -- retiring historical recovery executables -- reads as housekeeping rather than as the removal of the live Ramanujan system.
